'''Lulu''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked as a dancer in the repair asteroid station [[Darkside (space station)|Darkside]]. She moved her ears front and back while talking. Although she had heard of [[The Cell]], a criminal faction wanting to oust local crimelord [[Nirama]], she did not know The Cell had a presence in Darkside.
